Invariably, when I chat to product managers they say something like:

"I wish I had more time to be strategic, to be more thoughtful, to not be putting out fires, to not be juggling so many balls..."

What is getting in the way? Why is this so prevalent ?
product management roles are getting more and more overloaded. its a crazy people aren't burning out faster than they are already.

one big lesson of the last two years...

passionate (and experienced) problem solvers want flexibility, but they expect meaningful and coherent context. they want to know how leaders see the situation.

vague direction doesn't empower people

PdM tip ....

Don’t assume you need to learn everything that ppl like me and @shreyas and others rattle on about

Focus on your immediate challenge. Clarify the problem. Seek relevant advice. Experiment. Reflect.

Apply product thinking to how you learn. Don’t get distracted.
when you work on a product, you develop a level of myopia ... especially in B2B.
